newsitem.title: THAILAND: Christiani to float 7-for-5 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Christiani to float 7-for-5 rights issue.

text.p: Christiani and Nielsen (Thai) Plc said on Monday it will float a 7-for-5 rights issue of 224.6 million shares at 10 baht each by December 1996.
Construction contractors Christiani said at a press conference the planned rights issue would raise its capital to 3.85 billion baht from 1.60 billion.
The company announced the capital hike as it reported a sharply widened consolidated loss of 2.24 billion baht for the second quarter, up from a loss of 252.9 million a year ago.
Christiani shares, which were suspended on Monday, closed Friday at 10.25 baht.
